## Problem and stage

State the concrete question, stage ID, and dependency commit.

## Changes and resulting behavior

Explain the implementation and any protocol changes. Distinguish faithful reference behavior from corrections or proposed models.

## Evidence

Link the stage report, run index, raw metrics, source/results commits, and artifact inventory. State which gates were run and their actual outcomes, including failures and null findings.

## Resources and limitations

Report primitive steps, decision count, updates, circuit evaluations/shots, wall time, hardware, and remaining uncertainty. Do not present simulation runtime as physical quantum speedup.

## Publication and next action

State remote verification status and the next stage. Keep the completed stage branch after integration.
